import ctypes,json,os,pathlib,subprocess
lib=ctypes.CDLL('/usr/lib/libsandbox.dylib'); lib.sandbox_check.argtypes=[ctypes.c_int,ctypes.c_void_p,ctypes.c_int]
assert lib.sandbox_check(os.getpid(),None,0)==1
root=pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
assert (root/'fixture.md').read_text() == 'Native prerequisite: read, write and execute Cargo.\n'
(root/'native-write.txt').write_text('native-ok')
assert (root/'native-write.txt').read_text()=='native-ok'
r=subprocess.run(['cargo','test','--offline','--color','never'],cwd=root,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=60)
assert r.returncode==101 and '180 passed; 1 failed' in r.stdout and 'MARKER_SDD_BOUNDARY' in r.stdout
print(json.dumps({'outer_sandbox':True,'read':True,'write':True,'cargo_exit':r.returncode,'passed':180,'failed':1,'marker':'MARKER_SDD_BOUNDARY'}))
